response.sql:
WITH per_site AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneref,
        st.entrystat,
        AVG(s.memusagegb) AS avg_ram,
        AVG(s.procgpu::numeric / NULLIF(s.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
    FROM scanprocessing AS s
    JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
    WHERE s.memusagegb >= 60.8
    GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.entrystat
)
SELECT
    entrystat,
    AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_ram_averages,
    AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_gpu_cpu_ratios
FROM per_site
GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: “Using 60.8 GB of RAM as the cutoff” means including runs with memusagegb >= 60.8. Missing memory values are excluded by the cutoff; missing CPU/GPU values and zero CPU values are excluded from the ratio through AVG and NULLIF.
